sections.title: AI Services for Miami Healthcare Organizations
sections.description: Production AI solutions for Miami's world-class healthcare ecosystem.

blocks.heading: Jackson Health System Public Healthcare AI
paragraphs: Jackson Health System — Miami's public hospital network (Jackson Memorial Hospital, Jackson North, Jackson South) serving Miami-Dade County's uninsured, Medicaid, and safety-net patient population:

Multilingual clinical AI: AI for Jackson's extraordinarily diverse patient population — Spanish-English bilingual as baseline, with Haitian Creole, Portuguese, and other languages for Jackson's specific patient demographics. Jackson's patients speak 70+ languages — multilingual clinical AI is not optional at Jackson.

Miami-Dade social determinants analytics: ML incorporating Miami-Dade's specific social risk factors — housing instability in the Haitian American community, food insecurity in Overtown and Liberty City, transportation barriers for inner-city residents — into clinical risk models for Jackson's complex social needs population.
Florida Medicaid population health: Risk stratification and care gap identification for Jackson's large Florida Medicaid membership under Miami-Dade's managed care program.
Cost: $55,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | HIPAA + Florida Medicaid

blocks.heading: UHealth Academic Medical AI
paragraphs: University of Miami Health System (Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center, UHealth Tower, Bascom Palmer Eye Institute — one of the world's leading ophthalmology programs):

Ophthalmology AI: Computer vision for retinal imaging analysis, glaucoma detection, and diabetic retinopathy screening at Bascom Palmer — one of the world's largest ophthalmology programs sees extremely high volumes of retinal imaging that AI can assist.
Cancer center AI: ML for Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center's oncology programs — treatment response prediction and clinical trial matching for South Florida's large cancer patient population.
Clinical research AI: NLP and ML for UHealth's research programs — IRB-compliant clinical cohort identification and research data extraction for UHealth's NIH-funded research enterprise.
Cost: $60,000–$165,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks | HIPAA + IRB

blocks.heading: Baptist Health South Florida AI
paragraphs: Baptist Health South Florida (12 hospitals, the largest healthcare organization in South Florida by revenue):
Epic-integrated clinical AI: Population health ML and clinical deterioration prediction for Baptist's large Epic-integrated South Florida hospital network.

Cardiac and cardiovascular AI: Baptist Heart & Vascular Institute serves one of the US's most cardiovascular disease-affected populations — the aging Florida retiree community combined with Miami's immigrant population creates specific cardiovascular disease analytics demand.
Revenue cycle AI: Denial prediction, PA automation, and coding optimization for Baptist's large Florida payer mix (Florida Blue, UnitedHealth, Aetna, Medicaid).
Cost: $55,000–$145,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | HIPAA

blocks.heading: Digital Health and Telehealth
paragraphs: Miami's digital health startup community and the telehealth companies serving Florida's geographically dispersed population:
Multilingual telehealth AI for Miami's Spanish-English-Creole-Portuguese patient population.
Remote patient monitoring for Miami's large elderly and cardiovascular disease population.
Behavioral health technology with Florida-specific crisis resources and DCF (Department of Children and Families) integration.
Cost: $50,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | HIPAA + Florida FDBR

sections.title: Miami Healthcare AI Regulatory Context
sections.description: Key compliance considerations for Miami healthcare AI development.

blocks.heading: Florida Digital Bill of Rights
paragraphs: Florida's consumer privacy law creates data governance requirements for Miami's digital health applications using Florida consumer health data — ClickMasters designs Miami consumer health AI with FDBR compliance.

blocks.heading: Florida Agency for Health Care Administration (AHCA)
paragraphs: AHCA oversees Florida's healthcare quality and Medicaid program — clinical AI for Florida Medicaid must align with AHCA requirements and Florida Medicaid managed care organization contracts.

blocks.heading: Florida Mental Health Act (Baker Act)
paragraphs: Florida's involuntary mental health examination law creates specific legal context for behavioral health AI in Miami — ClickMasters designs Miami behavioral health AI with Baker Act framework awareness.

blocks.heading: Healthcare for Miami's immigrant populations
paragraphs: Miami's large undocumented immigrant population has access to emergency Medicaid — clinical AI for Jackson Health's safety-net programs must be designed with sensitivity to immigration status concerns in clinical risk documentation.

sections.title: Miami's Healthcare AI Differentiation Factors
sections.description: Miami's healthcare AI market has several characteristics that distinguish it from other major US healthcare markets.

blocks.heading: Tropical climate's health impacts
paragraphs: Miami's climate creates specific disease burdens — dengue fever risk (Miami is the only US city with endemic dengue transmission risk), Zika virus history, and heat-related illness during extreme weather create population health AI requirements specific to South Florida that clinical AI designed for northern climates doesn't address.

blocks.heading: Medical tourism and global health
paragraphs: Miami is a destination for medical tourism from Latin America — the University of Miami and Cleveland Clinic's Weston, FL hospital attract patients from across Latin America seeking specialty care. Clinical AI for Miami's medical tourism population must accommodate international patient profiles, foreign insurance documentation, and cross-border coordination.

blocks.heading: Health disparities in Little Haiti and Overtown
paragraphs: Miami's Little Haiti and Overtown neighborhoods have significant health disparities — hypertension, diabetes, and maternal mortality rates well above Miami-Dade averages. Jackson Health's and Baptist's community health programs serving these neighborhoods create specific population health AI demand for social determinants-integrated clinical AI.
